publication_safety.opinion: Publication-safe paper journal. Bands and labeling fix the earlier exact mark/basis pairing issue; nothing here authorizes live inference or reconstructs sizing.
privacy_findings: No quantities, prices, balances, account/order identifiers, absolute P&L, or NLV.
Open mark uses coarse bands (0% to +0.1% return; less than +0.05% of virtual basis), which does not pin down position weight.
Identifiers beyond public symbols and content hashes only; no private ledger contents exposed.
statistical_findings: Current vs prior basis epoch is separated; prior 1.97% is not pooled into current expectancy.
Marked vs realized is explicit; closed_trades 0; open mark can reverse.
Denominators stay honest: 0 of 20 resolved bracket outcomes; shadows/pre-trigger/capability blocks kept out of executable R.
Limitations correctly bound IEX-only intraday evidence and empty observation ledger.

disagreements_to_preserve: This XLRE fill is allowable paper sampling, not a 'good trade' narrative—informationally weak (laggard defensive, late day, narrow stop, macro inside horizon).
Registry lane count is not diversification; the sampled executable book remains reclaim-only until non-reclaim families produce resolved rows.
Aggressive posture at 7/10 without 20 eligible aggressive closes at average realized R >= +0.30 is owner preference, not earned sizing science.
Do not relabel day-two or BWMN-style paths as gap-fill reversion; keep counter-direction post-event gap-fill as a separate family or admit redundancy.
Multi-week momentum and implied-move work stay shadow/measurement; they do not patch today's reclaim monoculture by renaming.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: Executable book is still reclaim monoculture: 'Pooled level and VWAP reclaim', 'Day-two post-gap consolidation', and 'Negative-catalyst oversold reclaim' are one mechanism family with different costumes. Sector-pair RV, quality three-lower-close, and overnight/intraday decomposition are the only genuinely distinct lanes, and none of them drove this fill.
strategy_critique.missed_alternatives: A non-reclaim executable probe was available in principle (cross-sectional multi-week momentum shadow registry; earnings gap vs ex-ante implied-move feasibility; scheduled-macro stratification on the open reclaim) but none were required to block this paper sample. Stacking another defensive reclaim would not have been diversification. No alternative qualifies as a missed edge claim—only as missed measurement breadth.
strategy_critique.opinion: TRADE is defensible only as a single prospective pooled reclaim observation under hard gates—not as alpha. XLRE lagged the market and the actual leadership (energy), had no symbol catalyst, and carries a stop that is narrow versus normal movement plus overnight/macro path risk inside the hold. Rejecting XLP/PFE as same-factor duplicates and leaving dead triggers dead is the real process win. With 0 resolved family outcomes, risk_appetite 7 is preference theater until the aggressive R gate is earned.
